summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only validation of AURELIS VELA passed 100%. Loader fades within ~2.5s revealing WebGL canvas; HUD (logo-home, menu-button, sound-toggle, scroll-progress) all present. Immersive menu opens and contains all 7 new nav items (experience/material/performance/machine/configurator/design/contact) and each Lenis-scrolls to its target chapter (verified scrollY jumps and target rect in viewport). New Performance chapter renders the 4 giant numerals (1.85, 1,850, 400+, 700). New Machine chapter: all 5 system buttons update aria-pressed=true and change machine-readout text. Configurator: Body/Wheels/Interior options each toggle aria-pressed and update summary-body='Silver', summary-wheels='Sculpted', summary-interior='Midnight' as expected. Design chapter has 3 all loaded (naturalWidth>0) with '1.85 s' and '700' spec text in DOM. Zero uncaught JS/React errors captured (0 pageerror, 0 console errors) across the whole flow.
critical_code_review_comments: sound-toggle button does not set an aria-pressed attribute (returned None) — visible label 'SOUND OFF/ON' works fine, but adding aria-pressed would improve a11y/testability. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL loads with wait_until='domcontentloaded' (load event times out due to heavy WebGL bundle). Loader opacity reaches 0 in ~2.5s but element remains in DOM. Menu-driven navigation via Lenis works reliably; direct scrollTo also works. All 7 menu items resolve. Configurator, Machine, Performance, Design chapters are fully functional. No console errors observed.
